instruction: From the code cells in the Colab notebook, extract all the code and save it to a file called 'notebook_code.py' in the /home/user directory. Make sure to include all import statements.

metadata.explanation: Task extracts all code from Colab notebook. Gold file contains 7 import statements with modules torch and torch.nn, plus actual code implementation. Evaluator checks: (1) all 7 import statements present (0.3 points), (2) required modules torch and torch.nn are imported (0.3 points), (3) at least 15 lines of non-import code present to verify actual code extraction (0.4 points). This ensures the agent extracts all code, not just imports.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all key requirements: (1) imports are extracted (min 7), (2) specific required modules present (torch, torch.nn), (3) actual code content is extracted (min 15 non-import lines)
The min_code_lines check (15 lines) in the metric effectively distinguishes between files with only imports vs files with actual code implementation
Getter extracts necessary information: import_count, unique_modules, non_empty_lines which enables proper verification
Metric logic correctly calculates code_lines = non_empty_lines - import_count to verify non-import code content
Scoring is well-balanced: 0.3 for import count, 0.3 for required modules, 0.4 for actual code content
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Consider requiring min_imports=7 (exact match) instead of min_imports=7 (>= 7) if the gold file has exactly 7 imports, to ensure all imports are extracted without extras
